Muhlenberg College Courses

Selected classes and projects from a college education that brought together technical, creative, entrepreneurial, and humanities interests.

Computer Science Entrepreneurship Writing, Art & Humanities Japan MILA

Computer Science

My Computer Science major included programming, software development, data, and systems. Courses I took included:

  • Introduction to Game Programming
  • Computer Science II
  • Data Structures & Algorithms
  • Computer Organization
  • Web Software Development
  • Database Systems
  • Software Engineering
  • Machine Learning

KeepUp: Senior Capstone

I worked on the front end of a collaborative bookkeeping web application built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. My contributions included theme switching, loading states, and responsive interface components. We presented it at the department showcase.

View KeepUp on GitHub

Innovation & Entrepreneurship

My minor in Innovation & Entrepreneurship sat alongside my technical studies. It connected with my interest in developing ideas into ventures and thinking through how projects could work beyond the classroom.

Explore My Projects

Writing, Art & Humanities

Fiction Writing

Classroom writing and revision produced several pieces now included in my writing portfolio. Two stories were accepted by MUSES, Muhlenberg’s literary and arts magazine.

Explore My Writing

Art

Drawing and studio art were another part of my studies, alongside programming, writing, and entrepreneurship.

Humanities

My coursework also included subjects such as pilgrimage and Anne Frank, extending my studies beyond my major and minor.

Read “1080 Paths of Least Resistance” and “Just This Once”.

MILA: Ecology & Religion in Japan

One standout was my Muhlenberg Integrative Learning Abroad (MILA) experience: a course connecting ecology and religion that culminated in a two-week trip to Japan.

The course brought together environmental questions and religious traditions, with learning that continued beyond the classroom.
